Approved evidence

Deepen AI

org.deepen_ai

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. Deepen separates managed Annotate as a Service from the customer-run Annotate platform. The managed scope spans2D/3D/fused sensors, scenario and behavior tags. Custom collection is advertised separately; a coming-soon Refinery is not treated as a live marketplace. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
